r.name: Avenue Verte London ↔ Paris
r.description: English part of Avenue Verte London ↔ Paris, an international cycle route that connects the two capital cities

r.name: Greenwich Meridian Trail
r.description: A long-distance walk that follows the line of the Prime Meridian. Inaugurated in 2009, to coincide with the 125th anniversary of the Greenwich Meridian.

r.name: National Cycle Route 2 Hastings to Brighton
King Charles III England Coast Path: Shoreham to Eastbourne
Alfriston Clergy House Countryside Walk, Alfriston
r.description: Walk in the footsteps of the artists & writers of the Bloomsbury Group as you follow this circular to the 600yrs old Alfriston Clergy House (in the South Downs National Park). Take in downland views on route. Moderate terrain with 1 steep climb.

r.name: Alfriston Clergy House to The Long Man of Wilmington, Alfriston
Alfriston Clergy House to Berwick Church, Alfriston
Alfriston Clergy House to Lullington Church, Alfriston
Southease to Monk's House Circular Walk, Monks House
r.description: For Virginia Woolf, writing & walking were inseparable; she made her stories as she walked. Virginia & Leonard lived at Monk's House from 1919, where she walked for 2hrs+ daily. This walk takes you to places they loved. Paths can be muddy & wet in winter

r.name: Hill and Vale Walk at Frog Firle Farm, South Downs East
r.description: Looping over Cradle & Hindover Hills, see views of secluded farmland & divert to Litlington. Spot geese feeding on the water meadows, birds & insects singing in the hillside shrub, & wild flowers growing in the chalk grassland. Slopes & uneven terrain.

r.name: Seascapes and Saltmarsh Trail at Cuckmere Valley, South Downs East
r.description: Listen to seabirds, taste the salty tang of the air and enjoy sweeping views to the sea, over the South Downs and northwards towards the Weald on this Cuckmere Valley walking trail. The valley floor can be muddy in winter so outdoor shoes are advised.

r.name: Clifftop Walk From Birling Gap to Exceat, South Downs East
r.description: Experience iconic clifftop views of the Seven Sisters coastline and discover the history of this walk to Exceat and the Seven Sisters Country Park. Steep and uneven ground in places with steps.

r.name: Between The South Downs and the Sea Circular Walk, South Downs East
r.description: Start & end in Crowlink, go through meadows & trees, down towards Birling Gap & over 3 of the Seven Sisters. See great coastal views, seasonal wildlife & flower displays. Optional detours to a historic pub & a seaside café. Steep hills, stiles & gates.

r.name: Birling Gap from the Tiger Inn, South Downs East
r.description: Enjoy views over the downs & the East Sussex coast on this circular. By following old drovers' and smuggling routes to the sea from this small downland village you may also feel a sense of the landscape's long history. Gates & short steep sections.

r.name: European walking route E9, Queen Elizabeth Country Park to Jevington
Earls Walk, Sheffield Park
r.description: The southern section of this trail (through Ironsgate Mead) seasonally floods, so an alternate dry route has been suggested.

r.name: Estate Walk at Sheffield Park
r.description: Complement a visit to the stunning landscape gardens with an exploration of the historic parkland at Sheffield Park, East Sussex. Gentle slopes across grazed fields lead you by copses and down to the riverside flood meadow. Steep in places.
